notes.title: Patch Version 1.11 is now live with Custom Matchmaking!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Thank you for playing NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS.[/b][/h3]

A patch has been released, please see the following for the details.

[h2][b]Content[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]DLC Pack 1 [/b][/h3]
[list][*] Playable Character "Hagoromo Otsutsuki"
[*] Combination Secret Technique "Source of Ninshu" (Hagoromo Otsutsuki x Indra Otsutsuki x Ashura Otsutsuki)
[*] Matching Voice x12
[*] Ninja Info Card Image x5[/list]
*The content above is available for players who have purchased DLC Pack 1 or the Season Pass, which includes of DLC Packs 1 - 5. 
*DLC Pack 1 is planned to be released on January 25, 2024. Release date/time may differ depending on region.

[h3][b]Custom Matchmaking[/b][/h3]
Custom matchmaking has been implemented and allows a user to create a room for up to 8 designated players.

Users can now participate in the following modes for custom matches:
[list][*] VS Battle (2 players)
[*] League (4 players)
[*] Tournament (4-8 players)[/list]
[h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Other bug fixes and adjustments have been made.[/list]
Future patch updates are planned to include the "Ninja Battle" in-game event, balance adjustments, and DLC Packs.

[h3][b]We hope for your continued support of NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS. [/b][/h3]
